From Tusk, Ball Breaker · Price: limited ammo (your fingernails or steel balls regrow at 10 per day).

Theme Force and Energy

  • 1: 1 action: spinning nail shot, range 30 ft: @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[piercing]], attack with your stand's modifier. Uses one nail. A hit leaves a hole: 1d6 persistent bleed (2d6 from 13th), and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the start of your next turn; you can move through the hole with your stand, ignoring cover from that target. Surge, free action: regrow 5 nails at once.
  • 5: Surge: golden spin shot: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[piercing]], ignores resistance; on a hit the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1} for 1 round (1 minute on a critical hit), and the hole's bleed is doubled.
  • 9: A golden spin shot that hits also knocks the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone}.
  • 13: Nail shots range 60 ft and home around one cover.
  • 17: Surge, once per day: infinite spin: the target takes @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[piercing]] each round for 3 rounds (no save); it keeps chasing the target.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
